CITY OF AZUSA
  MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL
  MONDAY, JANUARY 25, 2016 – 6:30 P.M.

The City Council, of the City of Azusa, met in Special Session at the above date and time in the Azusa Light & Water
Conference Room, located at 729 N. Azusa Avenue, Azusa, California.

Mayor Rocha called the meeting to order at 7:09 P.M.

ROLL CALL: Roll call was taken by City Clerk Cornejo.

PRESENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: GONZALES, CARRILLO, MACIAS, ROCHA
ABSENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: ALVAREZ

ALSO PRESENT

Elected Officials: City Clerk Cornejo.
Staff Members: City Manager Butzlaff, City Attorney Martinez, Utilities Director Morrow, Police Chief Gonzalez,
Police Captain Hunt, Public Works Director/City Engineer Bobadilla, Management Analyst Lacasella, Administrative
Intern Campos, Associate Planner Munoz, and Administrative Technician Juarez.

COUNCIL RECESSED FOR BREAK AT 7:10 P.M. AND RECONVENED AT 7:20 P.M.

PUBLIC COMMENT

No public comment was given.

STUDY SESSION

COMMUNITY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.

Administrative Intern Carina Campos presented the details on the City’s Proposed Special Assistance Program which
would create a formal process for considering community funding assistance requests. Discussion ensued regarding
the eligibility requirements, the maximum grant amount allowed and what the funds should be used for. The Council
elected to allow grants up to $200 to be requested by community based groups and recognized clubs or sports teams
that are affiliated with a school within the jurisdiction of Azusa. The funds granted are only to be used for youth-
focused educational and enrichment purposes.

SCHOLARSHIP FUND PROGRAM.

Administrative Intern Carina Campos presented the proposed Scholarship Program which was funded by Vulcan
Materials Company as a condition of their development agreement, and would benefit both high school seniors and
adults advancing their career. Discussion ensued regarding acceptable schools, grade point average (GPA) and to
whom the funds would be dispersed to. The Council directed Staff to modify the qualifications to include acceptance
to an accredited college, university or trade school, a minimum GPA of 2.75, and ensure that scholarship funds are
given directly to the institution and not the individual.

DISCUSSION REGARDING PARKING RESTRICTIONS FOR CERTAIN COMMERCIAL VEHICLES ON
RESIDENTIAL STREETS.

Staff presented the staff report stating that the City had received various complaints regarding the parking of
commercial vehicles in residential districts. The Azusa Municipal Code classifies a commercial vehicle as that
weighing more than 10,000 pounds and Staff is seeking the Council’s direction on lowering the weight threshold to
allow for more enforcement. Discussion ensued regarding the proposed commercial weight threshold of 6,000
pounds, the limitation of parking in both residential and commercial areas, and hours of prohibited parking. The
Council directed staff to lower the commercial vehicle threshold to 6,000 pounds and restrict parking in both
residential and commercial areas from 12AM – 5AM. Once the changes are adopted, there will be a one year trial
period to allow for changes as needed.
 ADJOURNMENT

The meeting was adjourned by consensus of the City Council.

TIME OF ADJOURNMENT: 8:23 P.M.
